spans.s:
Words with a sense of स्तोक 'aa little', अन्तिक 'near', दूर 'far' and कृच्छ्र 'penance', ending in the Ablative -5th case are compounded with what ends in क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

The letters स् and the dentals when coming in contact with श् and the palatals, are changed to श् and palatals respectively.

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-word
